notes.title: Wick Update: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Thank you to all our players who made us aware of a bug that was preventing progression past the Library! This bug has been fixed now. 

Thank you all,

Studio Whip

notes.title: Wick Update: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you to all our players who have been pointing out bugs to us! We have been trying to get to all the bugs we've been made aware of, and we've fixed a couple so far.

Bug fixes in this update include:
[list]
[*] Added support for 2560 x 1440p
[*] Fixed a bug where the graphics menu was not displaying the currently selected options when being reopened
[*] Fixed a few places where the player could escape the map and fall into nothingness
[/list]

Again, thank you for pointing out bugs, and we hope you continue to do so in the future!

Thank you all,

Studio Whip

notes.title: Thank you Wick Players!
notes.content:
Hello, players of [i]Wick[/i]!

We want to thank everyone for showing their love of our game and making tons of content with it.  We truly appreciate everyone's input and feedback in their videos and also their reviews on Steam!  As a student game, we are blown away by the response we have received and again wanted to thank everyone!

We see your reviews and some comments regarding bugs, and we are looking into them and could have the opportunity to fix some of them in the future.  Also, we are closing in on 20K downloads and want to keep pushing past that!  Keep spreading the word of Wick and making content, the team is loving it and are so excited that so many people love [i]Wick[/i] too!

Thanks again and play on,

Studio Whip
